{
  "subtype": "faceted_decomposition",
  "concept": "operational_burden",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "is_outage", "is_constitutive_facet": false, "role": "cause", "rationale": "Whether a ticket is an outage is a property of the issue that drives burden, not a constitutive aspect of the burden itself; it is a severity/cause signal external to the concept."},
    {"name": "customer_impact_scope", "is_constitutive_facet": true, "role": "facet", "rationale": "The breadth of impact (single vs multiple vs whole tenant) is a genuine constitutive dimension of how much burden an issue imposes."},
    {"name": "issue_category", "is_constitutive_facet": false, "role": "external_predictor", "rationale": "The type of issue is a classifier of the ticket that predicts burden, not a part-of the burden concept."},
    {"name": "request_type", "is_constitutive_facet": false, "role": "external_predictor", "rationale": "A near-duplicate of issue_category; it categorizes the request, an external predictor rather than a facet of burden."},
    {"name": "system_component", "is_constitutive_facet": false, "role": "external_predictor", "rationale": "The affected component is an attribute of where the issue occurs, not an aspect of the burden itself."},
    {"name": "data_risk", "is_constitutive_facet": true, "role": "facet", "rationale": "Data risk/exposure severity is a constitutive dimension of operational burden (risk-weighted consequence)."},
    {"name": "blocker_type", "is_constitutive_facet": true, "role": "facet", "rationale": "The degree to which the issue blocks the customer's business is a genuine facet of the burden it creates."},
    {"name": "technical_root_cause", "is_constitutive_facet": false, "role": "cause", "rationale": "Root cause is explicitly a cause of the issue/burden, not a constitutive part of it."},
    {"name": "is_outage_or_incident", "is_constitutive_facet": false, "role": "cause", "rationale": "Restated duplicate of is_outage; a cause/severity signal external to the concept."},
    {"name": "system_component_affected", "is_constitutive_facet": false, "role": "external_predictor", "rationale": "Duplicate of system_component; the affected component is external context, not a facet of burden."},
    {"name": "blocker_or_dependency", "is_constitutive_facet": true, "role": "facet", "rationale": "Duplicate of blocker_type; captures the business-blocking facet of burden but overlaps."},
    {"name": "data_risk_or_exposure", "is_constitutive_facet": true, "role": "facet", "rationale": "Duplicate of data_risk; captures the data-risk consequence facet but overlaps."},
    {"name": "technical_root_cause_pattern", "is_constitutive_facet": false, "role": "cause", "rationale": "Duplicate of technical_root_cause; a cause external to the burden concept."}
  ],
  "facet_columns": ["customer_impact_scope", "data_risk", "blocker_type", "blocker_or_dependency", "data_risk_or_exposure"],
  "non_facet_columns": ["is_outage", "issue_category", "request_type", "system_component", "technical_root_cause", "is_outage_or_incident", "system_component_affected", "technical_root_cause_pattern"],
  "mutual_exclusivity": 0.15,
  "exhaustiveness": 0.35,
  "rationale": "Most added columns are external predictors or causes of burden (issue_category, request_type, system_component, technical_root_cause, is_outage), not constitutive parts of it. Only impact scope, data risk, and business-blocking severity function as true facets of operational burden. The set is heavily redundant: nearly every column appears twice under different names (is_outage/is_outage_or_incident, blocker_type/blocker_or_dependency, data_risk/data_risk_or_exposure, system_component/system_component_affected, technical_root_cause/technical_root_cause_pattern), destroying mutual exclusivity. Even among genuine facets there is overlap, and key constitutive dimensions of burden such as effort/time cost, volume/frequency, and reopen/escalation load are missing (resolution_minutes exists only in the original table, not as an added facet), so exhaustiveness is low."
}
